recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage 1960s-style reel-to-reel tape cover featuring a high-contrast, low-light photograph of a musical group framed by a thick, acid-yellow border with technical metadata and tightly packed, lowercase serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Acid yellow border framing a dark, grainy central photograph
Tightly kerned, lowercase display type overlapping the top of the image frame
Technical metadata blocks positioned in the top margin with geometric icons
Distressed, weathered paper texture across all color fields
coreInvariants: Lowercase serif display font with extreme negative tracking
Horizontal rule separating the header from the main image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central rectangular image occupying 60% of the vertical space, featuring figures in shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acid-yellow border acts as the primary frame, while the large display text serves as the focal entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting with technical logos, moving to the display title, then the central image, and ending at the bottom tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark negative space within the photograph to emphasize highlights on the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Acid Yellow/Chartreuse (Background border and text highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black/Dark Brown (Central image background and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Green (Technical badges at the top)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation yellow border contrasts with the low-value, desaturated central photograph.

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical strokes with fine horizontal serifs

composition.position: Top right of the image frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for titles paired with utilitarian, bold sans-serif for technical data.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif and tight-fitting nature of the display text.
Appropriate for the bold, utilitarian technical metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square layout with a thick acid-yellow border. In the center, place a dark, grainy, high-contrast photograph of a group of people in a low-light stage setting. Apply a heavy weathered paper texture with scuffs and edge wear across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a dark brown horizontal line above the photo. Place large, lowercase serif text in the top right, overlapping the photo edge. Add technical metadata in the top margin using bold sans-serif fonts inside green pill-shaped containers. Add a tracklist at the bottom in a small, bold sans-serif font separated by squares.

verificationChecks: Is the border a vibrant acid yellow?
Is the display text lowercase and touching?
Is the central photo dark with high-contrast highlights?
Is there a visible weathered/vintage texture?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the yellow border
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is lowercase where specified.
Verify the presence of the green technical badges.
Check that the photo looks like a vintage film print.
Confirm the acid-yellow border frames the entire composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Acid Yellow Border + High Contrast Grainy Photo + Tightly Kerned Lowercase Serif + Weathered Paper Texture = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
